task.title: M5: Hide whole folders, not just files
task.description:
Extend the per-repo hide feature from single files to folders. Right-clicking a directory compound in the Graph, Map, or compare Edges views, or a directory header in the ordinary and compare treemaps, offers Hide <dir>/ which hides every file under that path prefix (and nested folders). Hidden entries are stored in the same per-repo set with a trailing slash marking a folder; the filter drops files whose path starts with the prefix, their functions, edges, and modules, and removes emptied compounds. The N hidden chip lists folders with their trailing slash and lets you unhide them individually or Clear all. Hiding a folder that contains an already-hidden file keeps both entries; unhiding the folder leaves the file hidden.

Acceptance criteria:
- Right-click internal/webui in the workbook Graph or Map and choose Hide: the compound and every file under it disappear from all views, summary counts and compare totals drop, and the chip reads 1 hidden with internal/webui/ listed.
- Right-click a directory header in the treemap offers the same action; hiding from the compare treemap also removes the folder from the compare Edges graph.
- Unhide restores the folder; nested folder entries work (hiding internal/ removes internal/webui/ as well).
- Hidden folders persist across reload and never leak to another repo.
- Headless Chrome check on workbook and Capacitor with no console errors; the pure filter helpers get one new unit test for prefix matching.
